infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Detail uses your location to find nearby cleaners.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you choose to go online as a cleaner, Detail shares your location with the service while you are online and on an active booking so nearby customers can be matched and customers can follow your arrival.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Detail uses the camera to take job photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Detail uses your photos so cleaners can see the space or vehicle before bidding.
plugins.cameraPermission: Detail uses the camera to take job photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: If you choose to go online as a cleaner, allow Detail to share your location with the service while you are online and on an active booking so nearby customers can be matched and customers can follow your arrival.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Detail uses your location to find nearby cleaners. Cleaner location is shared only while online or on an active booking.
